_comment: Multi-metric quality baseline for CI. Absolute ceilings always apply; relative baselines apply only when the matching field is non-null. Populate/refresh relative fields with GIGASTT_BENCHMARK_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 on a machine with the model, then commit. Absolute ceilings are sized for GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest CPU runners (M1 numbers are much lower). WER relative baseline for 'bundled' is ~75 words so one differing word is ~1.3pp; tolerance_pp sits above that to absorb cross-environment FP jitter.
